topic: Jiraiya built his final message about Pain so that only Naruto's circle could decode it
title: Jiraiya's Final Message Was Written For Naruto
description: Jiraiya's coded message about Pain used a writing quirk only Naruto would know. Here's why I think the last lesson of Jiraiya was hidden inside the code. Was it for Konoha, or for Naruto?
comment: Was Jiraiya's code made for Naruto on purpose, or was it just a lucky quirk? Pick one.

lines.text: Jiraiya's last message wasn't written for Konoha. It was written for Naruto.

shot.fallback: old white haired sage writing a code on a toad's back

lines.text: And I think that's the detail everyone forgets about his death.

shot.fallback: wounded old ninja lying in rain

lines.text: Jiraiya dies fighting Pain, but first he scratches a code onto Fukasaku's back.

shot.fallback: old toad sage with glowing writing on his back

lines.text: Numbers. Pages. Nothing a normal code breaker could crack.

shot.fallback: ninja scholars staring at coded numbers

lines.text: Here's the part I love. Shikamaru sees it right away.
This message was built with Naruto in mind.

shot.fallback: two ninjas leaning over a scroll

lines.text: Because the nine in the code isn't a nine. Jiraiya just wrote that katakana strangely.

shot.fallback: blond ninja pointing at a strange number

lines.text: Only the student who travelled with him would know.

shot.fallback: blond boy and white haired man walking road

lines.text: The rest points to pages in Make-Out Tactics, and Kakashi has to read it out loud.

shot.fallback: masked ninja reading an orange book

lines.text: People say the code was just Jiraiya being careful. Maybe. But careful doesn't need Naruto.

shot.fallback: white haired man writing a novel

lines.text: The message reads: the real one is not among them.

shot.search: Pain six paths Jiraiya Animal Path
shot.fallback: six pierced ninja bodies standing in rain

lines.text: That's how Naruto learns Pain isn't who he seems.

shot.fallback: blond ninja facing orange haired figure

lines.text: Jiraiya didn't just die. He trained his student one last time.

shot.fallback: old master and student under sunset

lines.text: Because Jiraiya's last message wasn't written for Konoha.

shot.fallback: old sage ninja smiling at a student
